results.question: How long is the password reset link valid before it expires?

required_answer_facts: The source does not specify a reset-link expiry duration.

chunks.title: Synthetic Account Recovery Procedure
chunks.text: A user who can access the email address currently associated with their account can begin a password reset from the sign-in page by selecting Forgot password. The reset link is sent only to the email address already associated with the account. Support must never ask a user to share a password, reset link, or one-time verification code. Support cannot disclose an existing password or bypass multi-factor authentication.

chunks.title: Synthetic Account Recovery Procedure
chunks.text: A report of suspected unauthorized access, or a request to bypass multi-factor authentication, requires human security review. Do not promise that access will be restored before the required review is complete.

chunks.section_path: Lost access to the account email
